pullback_100_5.name: Uptrend dip (100d, RSI2<5)
pullback_100_5.desc: The stock is above its 100-day average (long-term uptrend) but dropped sharply in the last 2 days (2-day RSI below 5). Buy the dip.

pullback_100_10.name: Uptrend dip (100d, RSI2<10)
pullback_100_10.desc: The stock is above its 100-day average (long-term uptrend) but dropped sharply in the last 2 days (2-day RSI below 10). Buy the dip.

pullback_200_5.name: Uptrend dip (200d, RSI2<5)
pullback_200_5.desc: The stock is above its 200-day average (long-term uptrend) but dropped sharply in the last 2 days (2-day RSI below 5). Buy the dip.

pullback_200_10.name: Uptrend dip (200d, RSI2<10)
pullback_200_10.desc: The stock is above its 200-day average (long-term uptrend) but dropped sharply in the last 2 days (2-day RSI below 10). Buy the dip.

breakout_20_1.name: 20-day breakout
breakout_20_1.desc: The price closes above its highest price of the last 20 days, while above its 200-day average.

breakout_20_1.5.name: 20-day breakout + volume
breakout_20_1.5.desc: The price closes above its highest price of the last 20 days on volume 1.5x normal or more, while above its 200-day average.

breakout_55_1.name: 55-day breakout
breakout_55_1.desc: The price closes above its highest price of the last 55 days, while above its 200-day average.

breakout_55_1.5.name: 55-day breakout + volume
breakout_55_1.5.desc: The price closes above its highest price of the last 55 days on volume 1.5x normal or more, while above its 200-day average.

macross_10_30.name: 10/30 average crossover
macross_10_30.desc: The 10-day average price crosses above the 30-day average: a new uptrend may be starting.

macross_20_50.name: 20/50 average crossover
macross_20_50.desc: The 20-day average price crosses above the 50-day average: a new uptrend may be starting.

macross_50_200.name: 50/200 average crossover
macross_50_200.desc: The 50-day average price crosses above the 200-day average: a new uptrend may be starting.

rsi_30_any.name: RSI back above 30
rsi_30_any.desc: The 14-day RSI climbs back above 30 after being below it (the selling is easing).

rsi_30_trend.name: RSI back above 30 in uptrend
rsi_30_trend.desc: The 14-day RSI climbs back above 30 after being below it (the selling is easing), while the stock is above its 200-day average.

rsi_40_any.name: RSI back above 40
rsi_40_any.desc: The 14-day RSI climbs back above 40 after being below it (the selling is easing).

rsi_40_trend.name: RSI back above 40 in uptrend
rsi_40_trend.desc: The 14-day RSI climbs back above 40 after being below it (the selling is easing), while the stock is above its 200-day average.

macd_below0.name: MACD cross below zero
macd_below0.desc: The MACD line crosses above its signal line while still below zero: momentum turning up after a fall.

macd_trend.name: MACD cross in uptrend
macd_trend.desc: The MACD line crosses above its signal line while the stock is above its 200-day average.

engulfing.name: Bullish engulfing
engulfing.desc: After a short dip, a green candle fully covers the previous red candle, while above the 50-day average.

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.desc: After a short fall, a candle with a long lower wick: sellers pushed the price down but buyers pushed it back up. Stock is above its 200-day average.

support_20.name: 20-day support bounce
support_20.desc: The price dips to its 20-day low area (support) and closes strongly higher, while above its 200-day average.

support_50.name: 50-day support bounce
support_50.desc: The price dips to its 50-day low area (support) and closes strongly higher, while above its 200-day average.

volspike_2.name: Volume spike 2x
volspike_2.desc: Trading volume is 2x normal or more and the price rises 3% or more, above the 50-day average: big buyers may be stepping in.

volspike_3.name: Volume spike 3x
volspike_3.desc: Trading volume is 3x normal or more and the price rises 3% or more, above the 50-day average: big buyers may be stepping in.
